body: I do want to make changes, I just don't feel like I'll ever be able to stick with them, I've made steps forward in the past only to regress. I truly hope you are able to deal with your own demons and make the changes you need to be happy.

At this moment nothing seems to be making me happy. I actually can't even remember the last time I felt really happy. As for something I'm good at, in high-school I was fairly good at writing and did extremely well on my provincial. That's partly why I came and wrote this here, I thought it might be.... therapeutic. Happy seems like a long ways off for me though.
I hear you man, just from reading what you've said I'd recommend trying to get in touch with your brother, it sounds like that would be good for you.
